decisionsTitle: The declarations after the second review: three sentences, the safety rules on every group run's page, the proof of signing and the hold
decisionsSection:
**The review (relayed by the owner, 2026-09-29).** A second legal reading of the group-run self-declaration (the trail one, the weekly run on Tâmpa; §393, §503, §515, §523, §534) asked for three wording changes and one thing the platform must actually do. In its own words: «the paragraph on the electronic signature is good only if the platform keeps what it says: name + email + timestamp + the declaration's version + the exact text's hash + the acceptance»; «the PDF should print the version, the signing instant and the document hash»; «the database must not keep only accepted = true».

**1. Three sentences of the templates, and nothing else.** (a) The shoes name the safety outcome, not a category: «încălțăminte adecvată terenului, cu aderență corespunzătoare (de preferat pantofi de trail)» / «footwear suited to the terrain, with adequate grip (preferably trail shoes)», in the group-run trail text and the race's trail text. (b) «să respect indicațiile organizatorului și recomandările autorităților» becomes «să respect indicațiile generale de siguranță comunicate de organizator» / «to follow the general safety instructions communicated by the organiser» — what a run with no individual supervision and no mountain guide can promise — in the animals clause of the group-run trail text and of the race's trail text (the only places the phrase stood). (c) The retention sentence of both group-run texts: after the withdrawal, «O copie poate fi păstrată și după aceea, pe durata necesară constatării, exercitării sau apărării unor drepturi, inclusiv ținând seama de termenul general de prescripție de trei ani prevăzut de art. 2517 din Codul civil. Dacă există o reclamație, un litigiu sau o procedură în curs, documentul poate fi păstrat până la soluționarea definitivă a acesteia.» in place of «…; după expirarea acestei perioade, copia se șterge.» (EN twin), and the same in the privacy notice's §7 sentence on group-run declarations. The race declarations had no «copia se șterge» sentence; their three-year line gains only the dispute sentence, which is what the hold below implements. The privacy notice's race line is unchanged: its incident sentence already keeps data «până la soluționarea definitivă». The number of years stays the Civil Code's, as it was (§357). The health clause, the optional character and every other sentence are untouched; the club must approve new versions (below).

**2. «Reguli de siguranță» on every group run's page.** The declaration stays optional, so most runners never read it. Every group run's page now says the essentials it names, in seven plain lines inside «Condiții de participare» (§498), above the optional declaration: a group run of the club (`CLUB_NAME`) with no individual supervision and no (mountain) guiding — «ghidaj montan» on a trail, «ghidaj» otherwise, the words of that surface's declaration; each runner's own pace and way within the group; shoes and clothing for the ground and the weather, a headlamp on a night run; their own water and food; running only if, as far as they know, their health allows it; the organiser's general safety instructions for animals and weather; telling the organiser when they leave the group. Platform text in `messages/*.json`, both languages, no number and no editor field; the component draws nothing for any other type, so a race keeps its own rules section. The admin preview draws it too.

**3. The proof of signing.** Both acceptance tables — `declaration_acceptances` (a race) and `group_run_declarations` — already kept the version (`declaration_version`, §499), the version's hash (`content_sha256`, both languages of the approved template), the language, the typed name, the moment (`accepted_at`, to the microsecond) and, for a group run, the address; the tick is the row's existence. What they did not keep is the hash of **the exact text this person signed**. Migration `0110` (expand only) adds `text_hash` to both: the SHA-256, lower-case hex, of the declaration's title and every paragraph its PDF prints — a dropped paragraph dropped, each blank filled with the signer's own copy's value (the name, the documents as stored, the event's facts, the moment of signing), the inline marks stripped per run exactly as the PDF strips them — one line each, joined by a line feed, as UTF-8 (`legal-documents/domain/signed-text.ts`). It is computed in the transaction that writes the row, from the same functions the PDF fills its text with (`signedDeclarationValues`, `groupRunSignedFacts`/`groupRunSignedValues`), so the bytes hashed are the bytes printed — for the email link, the paper at the desk (its documents stay dotted blanks, as its record prints them) and the family wizard alike. The club's archive copy masks the identity document (§320) and is a copy of that text, not a second one. A unit test pins a known text to a known hex; integration tests prove each row carries the hash of its PDF's text.

The PDF (both kinds, both languages) prints «Versiunea N · Semnat la ZZ.LL.AAAA, hh:mm:ss (ora României) · Amprenta documentului (SHA-256): <hex>» / «Version N · Signed on DD.MM.YYYY, hh:mm:ss (Romania time) · Document fingerprint (SHA-256): <hex>» under the signature block and on every page of a signed entry, a line under the footer's own (set a step smaller until it fits the width); the version, the instant and the hash from the row, the instant on the club's clock (`formatSigningInstant`). A row from before the column prints the line without its hash part — never a hash computed now, which would prove only what the text says today. The blank form prints none. The archive copy prints the same line. The registration's backoffice page and the group-run signatures list show the hash's first twelve characters, the whole one in a tooltip and as the element's accessible name, to the Administrator and the Organizer who read them today.

**4. «Păstrează: reclamație / litigiu în curs».** The new retention sentence promises that a document under a complaint, a dispute or proceedings may be kept until they are settled; a sentence the code does not keep is a promise nobody can check. So an Administrator may mark an acceptance of either kind (`retention_hold`, with the reason, when and who, in the same migration): the retention sweep skips a registration while any of its declarations is held — the three-year delete and the unconfirmed-address delete — and every erase refuses it with a CONFLICT that the screen words (the single erase, the batch, an event's erase, a group-run erase, a group-run batch, the delete of a run's last date that would cascade it). Clearing it puts the row back on its ordinary schedule: the next sweep takes a race's, and the signer's erase request goes through for a group run's (whose rows no job deletes, §503). Both presses ask first (§384), toast, wear a padlock glyph, and write an audit row naming the Administrator, the typed reason and the row's id — never the person (`registration.declaration_hold_set`/`_cleared` on the registration's trail, `event.group_run_declaration_hold_set`/`_cleared` on the event's). Asserted on the server (`canManageRegistrations`, BR-REQ-060-01); the Organizer sees the held line and no form. The seven-day clearing of an identity document is not held: data minimisation over evidence, a question left to the owner.

**Refused.** A medical certificate or a list of conditions (the review liked the health clause as it is); changing the emails' words (the brief: only the PDF they carry changes — the group-run copy's «apoi o șterge» stays until the owner asks); a hash of the page as rendered in the browser (HTML differs by browser; the text the PDF prints is the one signed and kept); a hold that stops the seven-day identity-document clearing.

**What the club must do.** The club's step, on production after the release: /admin/legal → «Regenerează din șabloane» for the trail and asphalt group-run declarations, the two race declarations and the privacy notice → read each → approve. Until then the texts in force keep their old sentences; the safety rules, the fingerprint and the hold work at once.
changelogLine: - **The declarations after the second review** — trail shoes «cu aderență corespunzătoare», the organiser's general safety instructions, a copy kept for a right and a disputed one until settled; «Reguli de siguranță» on every group run's page; every new signature keeps the SHA-256 of the exact text signed, printed on its PDF with the version and the second it was signed; an Administrator may hold a declaration for a complaint or a dispute, which no sweep or erase takes. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The platform's group-run trail template and the race's trail template ask for «încălțăminte adecvată terenului, cu aderență corespunzătoare (de preferat pantofi de trail)» and for «indicațiile generale de siguranță comunicate de organizator», and no declaration template names «recomandările autorităților». Both group-run templates and the privacy notice's retention sentence for them keep a copy «pe durata necesară constatării, exercitării sau apărării unor drepturi», with the three-year limitation period of art. 2517, and a document under a complaint, a dispute or proceedings until finally settled; both race templates add that dispute sentence after their three years. Both languages (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `legal-documents/second-review-wording.test.ts`.

Every new declaration acceptance — by the email link, on paper or in the family wizard — stores `text_hash`, the SHA-256 in lower-case hex of the declaration's title and every paragraph its signed PDF prints, the blanks filled as the signer's copy fills them, lines joined by a line feed, computed in the transaction that writes the row. The signed PDF, the club's archive copy and every page of a signed entry print «Versiunea N · Semnat la ZZ.LL.AAAA, hh:mm:ss (ora României) · Amprenta documentului (SHA-256): <hex>» from the row, without the hash part on a row from before it; the blank form prints none. The registration's backoffice page shows the hash's first 12 characters with the whole one in a tooltip (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `legal-documents/signed-text.test.ts`; integration `registrations/declaration-proof.test.ts`, `registrations/signed-declaration.test.ts`.

An Administrator may mark a declaration acceptance «Păstrează: reclamație / litigiu în curs» with a reason, and clear it with a reason; each press asks first, toasts and writes an audit row naming the actor, the reason and the acceptance id, never the person. While it is set the retention sweep keeps the registration and its declaration past their period and every erase is refused; once cleared, the next sweep deletes them on schedule. Anyone below Administrator is refused on the server (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/declaration-proof.test.ts`.

Every group-run self-declaration signed from now stores `text_hash`, the SHA-256 of the exact text its PDF prints in the signer's language, computed before the row is written in the same transaction; the signer's PDF and the archive copy print the proof line from the row, and the backoffice signatures list shows the hash's first 12 characters with the whole one in a tooltip. An Administrator may hold a signature for a complaint or a dispute: while held, no erase — single, batch, or the delete of the run's last date — takes it; once cleared, the erase goes through, with an audit row for each set and clear naming the event and the declaration id, never the signer (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `group-run-declarations/proof-and-hold.test.ts`; e2e `group-run-declaration.spec.ts`.

Every group run's page shows «Reguli de siguranță» / “Safety rules” inside «Condiții de participare», above the optional declaration: seven short lines in both languages naming the club from `CLUB_NAME` — no individual supervision and no (mountain) guiding, the runner's own pace and way, shoes, clothing and a headlamp on a night run, own water and food, running only if their health allows it as far as they know, the organiser's general safety instructions for animals and weather, telling the organiser when leaving the group. No line names a number, «platforma» or «de obicei»; a race's page shows none of it (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `group-run-declarations/safety-rules.test.ts`; e2e `event-pages.spec.ts`, `group-run-declaration.spec.ts`.

An erase of a registration whose declaration is held for a complaint or a dispute is refused with CONFLICT — alone, in the batch, or with its event — and the refusal says the declaration is kept; nothing is deleted (2026-09-29, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/declaration-proof.test.ts`.
